SELECT 
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NBILLNO", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NCODE", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NLTR", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."DDATE", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."LTR1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."FAT1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."SNF1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."RATE1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."AMT1", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."LTR2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."FAT2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."SNF2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."RATE2", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."AMT2", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DSTART_DATE", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DEND_DATE"
FROM
    "BGK"."MILK_BILL_HEADER" "MILK_BILL_HEADER",
    "BGK"."VW_BILL_DETAIL2" "MILK_BILL_DETAIL",
    "BGK"."MILK_FORTNIGHT" "MILK_FORTNIGHT"
WHERE
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" = "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."VYEAR_CODE" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" = "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NFORTNO" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NBILLNO" = "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NBILLNO" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."NFORTNO" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."VYEAR_CODE"
ORDER BY
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" ASC,
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" ASC

bill_summary_header.sql:
SELECT 
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NLTR", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NMILK_AMOUNT", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NDEDUCTION", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NNET_AMOUNT", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFEED", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NADV", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH1", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH2", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFEED_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NADV_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFEED_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NADV_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH1_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH2_OPBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH1_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NOTH2_CLBAL", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NBONUS_ANAMAT"
FROM
    "BGK"."MILK_BILL_HEADER" "MILK_BILL_HEADER"
WHERE
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" = '2500' AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" = 43.
ORDER BY
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" ASC,
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" ASC
